integrity.independent_review: No independent scientific validation has been performed.
integrity.proof: Self-contained block classification and exact polynomial interpolation reduction provided in RESULT.md.
integrity.reproducibility: Standalone standard-library verifier enumerates original-definition labelings.

scientific_limitations: The enumeration is of minimum-weight labelings only, not all feasible labelings.
The one-leaf corona case is outside the theorem.
Exact counting hardness is proved under polynomial-time Turing reductions, not parsimonious reductions; no bounded-degree claim is made.
Full text of one earlier publisher article was not accessible during the literature comparison; priority risk from less-indexed results remains.
Finite computational verification is not a substitute for the infinite proof.
title: Optimal outer-independent two-rainbow labelings of star coronas
